title: roles.json
description: The five seat roles. prd_may_change and prd_may_read are the PRD's Roles table cells, verbatim; operations are the agent calls a seat of the role may make, which are the registry operations whose caller is one of callers; acts_as names the roles whose work a seat of the role does (a General seat does the work of the other four, contract decision GA-1); role_file says whether its briefing and its jobs' material carry a role file (none for a General seat, GA-2).

acts_as.description: The roles whose work a seat of this role does: itself, or every other role for General.

role_file.description: Whether a seat of this role gets its role file, api/config/role_files/<role>.md.
